rows.grounds: Bahuvrīhi compound describing the deity: mākīrṇa (scattered) + alaka (locks) + veṇi (braid) + abja-ja (lotus-born) + nayanā (eyes), in accusative feminine singular as object of meditation.
Fused form containing dhyāyet (optative of √dhyai, 'should meditate') and śuka-śyāmalām (dark like a parrot), accusative feminine singular agreeing with the deity.
